criteria.text: The Create Account screen has 4 fields: Name, Email, Password, Confirm password. All are required.
Name is 30 characters or fewer. Password is at least 8 characters and includes at least 1 number.
User Action: Clicks “Create account” with valid information. Expected System Behavior: The account is created, the user is logged in, and the “Your household” screen opens.
criteria.note: Shown end to end by e2e/account.e2e.test.ts (“signs up, logs out from the menu…”), which runs against every preview deployment. Creating a real account and session needs the database, which unit tests don't have.

criteria.text: User Action: Clicks “Create account” with any invalid fields. Expected System Behavior: All applicable errors show at once, inline under each field. Name and Email keep their values; both password fields are cleared.
User Action: Clicks “Already have an account? Log in.” Expected System Behavior: The Log in screen opens.
Error Condition: Name is empty. Message: “Name is required.”
Error Condition: Name is over 30 characters. Message: “Name must be 30 characters or fewer.”
Error Condition: Email is empty. Message: “Email is required.”
Error Condition: Email format is invalid. Message: “Enter a valid email address.”
Error Condition: Email is already registered. Message: “An account with this email already exists. Use a different email or Log in instead.”
Error Condition: Password is empty. Message: “Password is required.”
Error Condition: Password does not meet requirements. Message: “Password must be at least 8 characters long and include 1 number.”
Error Condition: Passwords do not match. Message: “Passwords do not match.”
Error Condition: Server error. Message: “Something went wrong. Please try again.” (banner above the form)
